cards.title: PK/PD Index Definition and Input Requirements
cards.claim: PK/PD indices must be explicitly defined with their units, exposure window, and concentration basis (total vs. free). MIC-normalized indices require strain-matched MIC data with defined measurement context. Non-MIC-normalized exposure summaries do not require MIC. The label 'fT' is incomplete without specifying the threshold and whether the output is a duration or percentage.
conditions: When calculating or comparing exposure indices.
When distinguishing between exposure summaries and exposure-response fits.
required_inputs: For MIC-normalized indices: Strain-matched MIC value, units, and measurement method.
For fT>MIC: Specific threshold value and definition.
limitations: Do not infer MIC normalization from an abbreviated label.
Do not borrow MICs from other drugs or strains.
An EDA quotient using matched MIC retains the numerator's provenance; the ratio is not a measured concentration.
cards.downstream_use: Preparation of data for index ranking or PD target estimation.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
